title: 印度文化软实力如何转化为经济动力
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: India is a cultural giant, it makes more films in any other country on Earth, reaches hundreds of millions of viewers and has turned cricket into one of the world's most lucrative sports with the largest fan following after soccer.
segments.zh: 印度是文化巨人，电影产量全球第一，观众数以亿计，还把板球打造成全球最赚钱的运动之一，粉丝规模仅次于足球。

segments.en: But scale at home is one thing, building a global audience is another.
segments.zh: 但国内规模是一回事，打造全球受众是另一回事。

segments.en: South Korea turned K-pop into a worldwide phenomenon, Japan built global fandoms around anime and video games and even China has found its own viral moment with the rise of China-Mexing.
segments.zh: 韩国把K-pop变成全球现象，日本围绕动漫和电子游戏构建了全球粉丝群，甚至中国也凭借中国美学的兴起找到了自己的传播时刻。

segments.en: Meanwhile, India, despite its rich history and immense scale, attracted fewer foreign tourists last year than tiny Singapore or even Albania.
segments.zh: 与此同时，印度尽管历史丰富、规模庞大，去年吸引的外国游客却比小小的新加坡甚至阿尔巴尼亚还少。

segments.en: So why is a nation with such vast talent, creativity and diversity struggling to capture the world's imagination?
segments.zh: 那么，一个拥有如此巨大人才、创造力和多样性的国家，为何难以吸引世界的想象？

segments.en: We need to start looking at the world as our stage and we need to start looking less at India as the stage where we want to win.
segments.zh: 我们需要开始把世界当作我们的舞台，而不是只把印度当作我们想赢的舞台。

segments.en: But when you have a stadium full of Indians, 100,000, 35,000 Indians cheering and 800 million people watching it on hotstar and star sports, you really can become complacent very quickly.
segments.zh: 但当你有一个满是印度人的体育场，10万、3.5万印度人欢呼，8亿人在Hotstar和Star Sports上观看时，你真的会很快变得自满。

segments.en: Uday Shankar is the vice chairman and strategic force behind Joestar, India's largest media and entertainment conglomerate.
segments.zh: 乌代·尚卡尔是印度最大媒体和娱乐集团JioStar的副董事长兼战略推动者。
